$comment: TEMPLATE FILL-IN — copy to perf-probe.config.json. scripts/perf-probe.mjs measures the RAW compressed transfer of these pages (node:https, not fetch, so byte counts are what crossed the wire). Pick real, live pages; mark one real image variant with "image": true if you serve an image route. The probe refuses private, loopback and link-local addresses (127.0.0.1, 10.x, 169.254.169.254, a name resolving to one) and client scripts on another origin; to probe a local build, add "allowPrivate": true.
